snippet.title: 비 오는 날 길에서 구조한 고양이가 사고를 너무 많이 칩니다.. 하.. 어쩌면 좋을까요..?
snippet.description:
라랑하는 곰퐝이 여러분!
오늘은 여러분들이 좋아하시는 연어와 라온이의 영상을 가지고 왔습니다!
연어가 어느덧 구조되어 가족이 된 지 7개월이 됐습니다!
그 동안 연어는 정말 건강하게 잘 컸고
건강하게 잘 큰 만큼 사고를 치고 다닙니다..ㅎㅎ
고양이를 처음 가족으로 맞이 하다 보니 고양이의 호기심을
제가 미처 모르고 간과하여 아주 작은 사고가 일어났는데
다행히 우리 온동이가 다치지 않아서 
연어를 혼내기 보단 연어를 못 가게 막는 방법으로 방어 중 입니다 ㅎㅎ
더욱 조심해서 다들 잘 살 수 있도록 만들어 보겠습니다!
영상 보시고 조금이라도 웃으시는 하루 되셨으면 좋겠습니다!
오늘도 좋은 하루 보내세요!!
라랑해요!!

en-US.title: The cat I rescued from the street on a rainy day is causing so much trouble... Ha... What should ...
en-US.description:
Hello, my beloved Gomppang fans!

Today, I’ve brought you a video of Salmon and Raon, whom you all love!

It has already been 7 months since Salmon was rescued and became part of our family!

During this time, Salmon has grown up really healthy, and, as healthy as she is, she goes around causing trouble... haha.

Since this is the first time I’ve welcomed a cat into the family, I overlooked her curiosity and a very small accident occurred.

Fortunately, our Ondong wasn't hurt, so instead of scolding Salmon, I’m defending her by blocking her from going anywhere else haha.

I will be even more careful to ensure everyone lives well!

I hope watching this video brings you a smile, even if just a little, today!

Have a great day today!!

en-US.title: Let's catch and eat the one that seafood lovers go crazy for!
en-US.description:
Hello, my beloved Gompwang fans!

Today, I went on a fixed net in Goseong with Brother Im Posu and Brother Macho,

and caught a really delicious one to eat!

I didn't know this particular fish would come out in schools,

but this was the first time I've ever caught this many while using a fixed net!

I've tried catching them with a fishing rod, but catching a big one that way isn't easy,

so it was tough every time I did it. But this time, so many huge ones came out in the fixed net,

en-US.title: Please save me...
en-US.description:
Hello, my beloved Gomppang fans!

Today, I went to a rural village called Isan in Thailand and caught a monster fish using a very unique method, and tried eating it as a local dish!

I was actually quite surprised by the local cuisine, which was even more extreme than the Amazon...

But I was even more surprised because it was tastier than I expected!

Also, the method of catching the fish called *Pak Kai* was incredibly fascinating,

and since it is a method you can't encounter in Korea, it was a very fresh experience!

I met such wonderful people and had a great time filming,

so I would be grateful if you all watched it!

And unfortunately, this is the last episode of Thailand,

but thank you so much for enjoying the Thailand episodes so far!!

Have a great day today~!!

I love you!

snippet.description:
라랑하는 곰퐝이 여러분!
오늘은 태국 시골인 이산이라는 지역으로 가서
현지 유튜버분들을 만나 한국에서는 할 수 없는
석궁으로 물고기를 잡아서 먹어봤습니다!
이게 보우피싱 이라고 하는데 우리나라에선 현재 할 수 없기 때문에
해외에서 해볼 수 있어서 너무 뜻 깊었던 촬영이었습니다!
실제로 보우피싱을 해본적이 있지만
보우피싱 자체가 워낙 어려운 장르이기 때문에 
현지 분이 잡아주셨습니다!!
그리고 많은 현지 분들과 맛있게 그리고 즐겁게 촬영 해서
너무 행복했습니다!!
여러분들도 영상 보시면서 잠시나마 행복하셨으면 좋겠습니다!

Hello, my beloved Gomppang fans!

Today, I traveled to a rural area in Thailand called Isan, met some local YouTubers, and tried catching and eating fish with a crossbow—something you can't do in Korea!

en-US.description:
Hello, my beloved Gomppang fans!

Today, I swam out to an uninhabited island from the sea off Phuket, Thailand, and tried to survive!

It is a truly beautiful sea, but, as expected, it was scary at night!

Fortunately, the island wasn't too far away, so I swam over and caught some food!

I had such a happy time filming because I was with such wonderful people!

snippet.title: 망망대해의 배 위에서 24시간 살아남아보자!
snippet.description:
라랑하는 곰퐝이 여러분!!
오늘은 배를 타고 24시간 살아남아 봤습니다!
사실 배 위에서 살아남기를 국내에서 하고 싶었는데
어떻게 기회가 돼서 우리나라가 아닌 태국 푸켓에서 하게 됐습니다!
어떻게 보면 우리나라에서 하는 것 보단 여러분들이 보실때

snippet.title: 제가 드디어 잡았습니다!! 3일 동안 배를 타서 잡은 청새치를 먹어보자!
snippet.description:

해외편 많이 기다리셨죠?!
제가 이번엔 태국에 갔습니다!!
태국에서 뭘 잡았냐!! 바로!!
청새치를 잡았습니다!!
원래 태국엔 돛새치가 많아서 돛새치를 잡으러 간거였는데

en-US.title: I finally caught one!! Let's eat the blue marlin I caught after spending 3 days on a boat!
en-US.description:
My beloved Gomppang fans!

You've been waiting a long time for the overseas episode, haven't you?!

This time, I went to Thailand!!

What did I catch in Thailand!! That is!!

I caught a blue marlin!!

Originally, I went there to catch sailfish because there are a lot of them in Thailand,

but against all odds, a blue marlin appeared...!!!

I spent 10 million won trying to catch billfish in the US and didn't get a single bite,

but in Thailand, I finally caught one after 3 days! And it was a blue marlin!!!

I was so incredibly happy and had so much fun!!

I tried my best to capture the whole process of catching it in the video,

so I hope you enjoy watching it!

Have a great day today!!

I love you!!

en-US.title: I'll be back soon with my family.
en-US.description:
Hello, my beloved Gomfwang fans!

Today is a family travel vlog!

It was my first time traveling to Japan with Raon.

It felt like a whole new experience to go again after Raon was born, especially since Eunhye and I went together when I was heavily pregnant!

Of course, there were many difficult moments because of Raon, but ultimately, it was a happier trip, so I really enjoyed it!

so thank you so much!!
Have a great day today!!

snippet.title: 여러분들 덕에 우리 라온이가 많이 컸습니다
snippet.description:
라랑하는 곰퐝이 여러분!
오늘은 여러분들이 좋아하시는 가족 브이로그 입니다!
사실 조금 빨리 업로드 하려 했던 영상인데
영상 스케줄 때문에 늦어졌습니다!!
그래서 뒤늦은 크리스마스가 나오지만..!
크리스마스때의 추억을 회상하시며 보시면 좋을 것 같습니다!
철없는 부모가 아기를 낳고 사는 과정이라고 생각하시면서
보시면 더욱 재밌게 시청할 수 있지 않을까 생각합니다!
라온이한테도 산타할아버지가 되어 줄 수 있어서
너무 행복했습니다!
저의 어릴때의 행복했던 추억을 라온이가 겪고 있다고 생각하니
뭉클하면서 뿌듯합니다!
오늘도 좋은 하루 되시고

en-US.title: Wow.. This is ridiculous..!! Let's catch the legendary fish, the squid, and eat it!
en-US.description:
Hello, everyone!

Today, I caught a ton of fish on the Imjin River ice, a sport I only get to do three days a year!

I caught a ton of fish!

I caught a giant grass carp, an invasive species that grows incredibly large!

It was truly a dreamlike experience,
but I was so lucky to succeed!!

I was so excited and had so much fun filming it!

Grasping carp is a species of ecological concern because it destroys many of our native fish spawning grounds!

While it's not an invasive species, it's one of those fish species that's better off not being found in Korea!

So, I ate it deliciously!!

I had so much fun filming it, and I'm so happy the content was a success!

I hope you all enjoyed the video, even if only for a moment!

Have a great day today!!

Laranghaenge!!

en-US.title: Let's survive the extreme cold of -17 degrees Celsius with just a plastic bag!
en-US.description:
Hello, all you Larang Gomtangs!!
Today, I experienced a truly bitter cold spell..!!
And it was a whopping -17 degrees Celsius!
It was so cold that everything felt like it was freezing, but by catching things and being active,
it wasn't as cold as I thought it would be!!
However, it was so cold when I was sleeping that it was a bit difficult!
But it reminded me of my time in the military and made me reminisce!
Please don't force yourself to do this,

Next time, I'll try experiencing bitter cold somewhere even colder!!
Have a great day today!
Larrang!!

en-US.title: Wow... why is this so delicious..? Let's catch and eat a giant moonfish with a strangely shaped m...
en-US.description:
Hello, all you Larang Gomtangs!
Today, I caught a giant moonfish and grilled it with a torch!
I've seen moonfish a lot, but this was the first time I've seen one this big.
I was so curious about the sashimi, so I took it home and cooked it...
and I was so...so...so...so amazed at how delicious it was!!!
If you ever see moonfish, you should definitely try grilling it with a torch!
The oiliness is crazy...!
Or maybe it's because this one is so big,
but it was incredibly fatty and delicious..!!!
Next time, if I come across a moonfish even bigger than this one, I'll make a different dish!
Have a great day,
and thank you for watching the video!!
Larranging!!

en-US.title: Let's catch a giant shark that eats seasonal fish and eat it as sashimi!
en-US.description:
Hello, all you Larang Gomtwips!
Today, I caught a shark that preys heavily on seasonal yellowtail, and ate it as sashimi and grilled fish!
Currently, sharks are overeating yellowtail,
so the price is skyrocketing, and fishermen who make a living from it are suffering significant losses!
This is the time of year when you need to sell a lot of yellowtail to make a living,
but sharks are taking 9 out of 10.
This is why yellowtail is so scarce, and the price is skyrocketing!
So, I tried catching sharks myself, and there were a ton of them!
It was very windy and the swells were rough, but we caught a lot of sharks,
so I had fun filming!
I hope you all enjoyed it too!!
Have a great day!
Larang!

snippet.title: 3일 동안 산을 뒤져서 잡은 거대한 멧돼지를 꿔바로우로 만들어 먹어보자!
snippet.description:
라랑하는 곰퐝이 여러분!
오늘은 멧돼지를 잡아서 꿔바로우와 갈비로 만들어 먹어봤습니다!
이번에 멧돼지 퇴치는 정말 힘들었습니다..!
포기하고 싶은 순간이 많았지만 영상을 위해서 힘이 나더라구요!
험한 산 속에서 생채기가 많이 났지만 영광의 상처라고 생각합니다 ㅎㅎ
그리고 꿔바로우와 갈비로 먹었는데 생각보다 
너~무 맛있어서 깜짝 놀랐습니다..!!
멧돼지 고기를 파는 식당이 있는데 장사가 잘 된다고 합니다!
저도 이 정도로 맛있을 줄 몰랐는데 생각보다 너무 맛있었습니다!
멧돼지 퇴치는 힘들지만 늘 스릴 있고 재밌어서 
즐겁게 촬영 했습니다!
여러분들도 보시고 행복한 하루가 되셨으면 좋겠습니다!

en-US.title: Let's make a kuabarou with the huge wild boar we caught after searching the mountains for three d...
en-US.description:
Hello, all you Larang Gomtangs!
Today, I caught a wild boar and made it into kua ba rou and ribs!
Slaying the wild boar this time was really hard...!
There were many moments when I wanted to give up, but the video gave me strength!
I got a lot of scratches on the rugged mountain path, but I consider them honorable scars. Haha
And I ate kua ba rou and ribs, and I was surprised at how delicious it was...!!
There's a restaurant that sells wild boar meat, and I heard it's doing well!
I didn't expect it to be this delicious, but it was even better than I expected!
Slaying wild boars is hard, but it's always thrilling and fun, so I had a great time filming!
I hope you all had a wonderful day watching it!
Have a great day today!!
Lalarang!!

snippet.title: 우리나라에서 잡은 열대어를 통째로 먹어보자!
snippet.description:
라랑하는 곰퐝이 여러분!
오늘은 우리나라에 살고 있는 외래종 열대어를 잡아서
먹어봤습니다!
우리나라 구피천이라고 불리는 곳은
1년 내내 따뜻한 물이 흐르기 때문에 
아주 많은 외래종들이 살고 있습니다!
하지만 이 외래종들은 결국 유기 때문에
이 곳에 살고 있는 생물들입니다!
반려동물 시장이 많이 커 져서
많은 사람들이 열대어, 파충류 등등 반려동물과 함께 지내고 있습니다!
하지만 이렇게 시장이 커질수록 유기도 많이 생기는 것 같습니다!
결론은..유기 하지 않으셨으면 합니다!!
그리고 사실 열대어를 못 잡을 줄 알았는데
포기하지 않고 한번 더 가서 잡았습니다!
너무 행복했습니다!!ㅎㅎ
여러분들도 오늘 좋은 하루 되시고 
영상 보시면서 행복하셨으면 좋겠습니다!
좋은 하루 되세요!
라랑해요!!

en-US.title: Let's eat whole tropical fish caught in our country!
en-US.description:
Hello, lovely Gomtangs!

Today, I caught and ate an invasive tropical fish species native to Korea!

Because warm water flows through the area known as the Guppy Stream in Korea,

many invasive species live here!

However, these invasive species are ultimately abandoned,

because they are endangered!

The pet market has grown so much,

that many people are keeping tropical fish, reptiles, and other pets with them!

However, as the market grows, it seems that more and more are being abandoned!

In conclusion... I hope you don't abandon them!!

And honestly, I thought I wouldn't be able to catch a tropical fish,

but I didn't give up and went back and caught one!

I was so happy!! Haha

I hope you all have a great day today,
and that you enjoyed watching the video!

Have a great day!

Laughing!!

snippet.title: 어마어마하게 많은 물고기를 잡아서 가장 큰 녀석을 회로 먹어보자!
snippet.description:
라랑하는 곰퐝이 여러분~!
오늘은 정치망 조업 배를 타서 엄~~~청나게 큰 삼치를 잡아서
회로 먹어봤습니다!
지금까지 촬영 하면서 큰 삼치들을 많이 봤었는데
이번 삼치는 지금까지 본 것 중 가장 컸습니다..
실제로 보면 정말 엄~~청 큽니다!!
그리고 삼치는 선도가 빨리 상해서 잡자마자 회로 먹어야 하기 때문에
보통 회 보다는 구이나 찌개 용으로 많이 소비가 됩니다!
하지만 정치망을 타면 신선한 삼치를 회로 먹을 수 있는 기회가 있어서
너무 맛있게 먹고 왔습니다!!
여러분들 덕에 귀한 경험 했습니다!
늘 감사합니다!!

재밌게 봐주시면 너무 감사드리겠습니다!

en-US.title: Let's catch a ton of fish and make sashimi out of the biggest ones!
en-US.description:
Hello, everyone!
Today, I caught a huge tuna on a fixed-net fishing boat and ate it as sashimi!
I've seen a lot of huge tuna while filming,
but this one was the biggest I've ever seen.
It's really huge in person!!
And tuna spoils quickly, so it needs to be eaten as sashimi right after it's caught,
so it's usually used more for grilling or stew than as sashimi!
But by fishing on a fixed-net fishing boat, I had the opportunity to eat fresh tuna as sashimi,
and it was delicious!!
Thanks to you all, I had a wonderful experience!
Thank you always!!
I had a lot of fun filming this video, so I'd be so grateful if you enjoyed it too!
Have a great day!!
Hello, everyone!

snippet.title: 폭우가 내리는 정글에서 살아남아보자!
snippet.description:
라랑하는 곰퐝이 여러분!
이번 영상은 오키나와 캠핑카 여행 마지막 영상입니다!
그 동안 오키나와 영상 봐주셔서 너무 람사합니다!!
마지막 날에 하필 태풍이 불어서 상황이 너무 안 좋았지만
그래도 비 오는 날 언제 이렇게 해보겠냐는 생각과 함께
즐겨보니 너무 재밌었습니다!

집으로 오던 추억이 생각나서
편집하며 영상 보는 내내 마음이 몽글몽글 했습니다 ㅎㅎ

snippet.description:

snippet.title: 남자 둘이 섬에 갇혀서 24시간 동안 살아남아보자!
snippet.description:
라랑하는 곰퐝이 여러분!
오늘은 제주도에 있는 작은 섬에 갇혀서
24시간 동안 자급자족으로 잡아 먹으며 살아남아봤습니다!
최근 24시간 살아남기 했던 영상 중 가장 힘들었지만
통발에 생각도 못한 성과가 나와서 너무 행복했습니다!
그리고 촬영 내내 너무 재밌어서 행복하게 촬영 했습니다!
이제 겨울이라 어디서 살아남아야 할 지 모르겠지만
재밌는 곳에서 행복하게 잡으며 살아남아 보겠습니다!!ㅎㅎ
여러분들은 그저 영상 보시며 한 주에 제 영상 올라가는 딱 두 번만
피식이라도 하신다면 전 그거로 만족합니다!
오늘도 좋은 하루 되세요!!

snippet.title: 잠수해서 잡은 희귀한 해산물을 먹어보자!
snippet.description:
라랑하는 곰퐝이 여러분!
오늘은 트럼펫피쉬라고 불리는 홍대치를 잡아서 먹어봤습니다!
사실 정말 잡아보고 싶었는데
제주도에서 잠수 하지 않으면 잡을 수 없는 녀석이라 포기하고 있었다가
조례가 풀리면서 잠수가 가능해져 도전 했는데
운 좋게 잡을 수 있었습니다!
사이즈는 더 커진다고 합니다! 나중엔 더 큰 녀석을 잡아서 먹어보겠습니다!
그리고 역시 잠수 하니까 그 외 더 많은 생물들을 보고 잡을 수 있어서
촬영 내내 너무 재밌었습니다!!
여러분들도 영상 보시며 대리만족 하셨으면 좋겠습니다!!
영상 재밌게 봐주시고
오늘도 좋은 하루 보내세요!!
라랑해요!!


-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

en-US.title: Let's eat rare seafood caught by diving!
en-US.description:
Hello, everyone!
Today, I caught and ate a red snapper, also known as a trumpetfish!
Actually, I really wanted to catch one,
but I gave up because it's impossible to catch without diving in Jeju Island.
Until the ordinance was lifted, diving became possible, and I was lucky enough to catch one!
They say it grows even bigger! I'll try to catch and eat an even bigger one later!
And of course, diving allowed me to see and catch even more creatures,
so the whole filming was so much fun!!
I hope you all enjoy the video!!
I hope you enjoy the video,
and have a great day today!!

Laughing!!

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We catch and cook a variety of creatures.
We raise rare sea creatures.
